messages:
morgan: Heads-up — I'm planning a contract-gated rollout for per-tenant smart routing (feature.per_customer.smart_routing). Targeting 3 VIPs first (acme_corp, boutique_llc, bigretail). Need quick ops checklist + a tiny migration in the flags service. Can we coordinate?
priya: Quick Q — will this be implemented as tenant-scoped flags or a contract-level allowlist? Which service stores the mapping?
alex_r: Implementation plan: tenant-scoped flags stored in flags-service. We'll add entries under feature/per_customer/smart_routing/{tenant_id}. Value semantics: off | on | rollout_<pct>. Example in PR.
priya: ack, makes sense. Also, billing needs a heads-up for possible dedicated capacity increase for VIP traffic. Tagging billing after plan confirmed.
dana: Ops checklist draft: 1) create allowlist entries in flags-service 2) RBAC: only platform:toggle can flip enterprise flags 3) define canary groups + windows 4) add trace tag tenant=<tenant_id> to routing logs 5) set alerts (latency, errors, cost).
sam: I'll create the allowlist entries and set RBAC. @dana can you own canary monitoring + define rollback thresholds?
dana: Yep. Rollback triggers proposal: p95 latency > baseline * 1.20 OR error rate delta > 0.5% absolute OR cost spike > +30% in 1h. Also add a manual rollback button in console.
infra-bot: flag-service: created flag feature/per_customer/smart_routing/acme_corp id=flag_8273
morgan: Proposed rollout plan: (A) VIP phase: enable 'on' for VIP tenants listed in contract metadata (3 tenants) — monitor 48h. (B) Canary: increase to rollout_20 for 20% of enterprise tenants with contract clause for 72h. (C) Gradual ramp to full on per-customer opt-in. Fallback: explicit fallback route `legacy_routing` if any trigger fires.
priya: Note: Billing ticket created #BILL-412 for projected cost delta during canary. Also flag legal review for contract gating. @melissa_contracts can you confirm legal/contract language?
melissa_contracts: Confirmed — legal OK with contract-gated features, but we need SLA and cost disclosure in the VIP addendum. I'll update the template and send to sales.
alex_r: PR ready: https://git/repo/pull/3214 — adds tenant flag resolution + fallback. Small sample of resolution logic in the PR:
```js
// resolve per-tenant smart routing
const flag = flags.get(`feature.per_customer.smart_routing.${tenantId}`)
if (flag === 'rollout') {
  const sampled = Math.random() < rolloutPercentage
  useSmart = sampled
} else {
  useSmart = flag === 'on'
}
if (!useSmart) route = legacyRouting(req)
```
alex_r: Also adding a migration to create the allowlist entries for the 3 VIP tenants and a smoke test that asserts requests carry tenant tracing tag.
morgan: Ops: do we want a hard VIP bypass that always routes VIPs through smart routing? I'm worried about bypassing autoscaling/cost controls if we do that.
sam: Strong -1 on bypassing autoscaling. We can prioritize VIP traffic (routePriority=high) but still enforce capacity quotas and billing. If we alter scheduling, it must still consume tokens and respect quota.
priya: Agreed. VIP ≠ free pass. Also add a flag property 'billing_exempt' default false.
dana: Final ops runbook (short):
- pre-checks: confirm flag exists + allowlist ids match contract ids
- create canary label: canary_group=vip_phase1
- start canary: set flag values to 'on' for the 3 VIP tenants
- start monitoring: p95, p50, error rate, request cost, infra CPU/GPU
- escalation: rollback if p95 > baseline * 1.25 OR errors > 0.8% OR unexpected token cost > +30%
- postmortem channel: #incidents
Command examples:
```
# enable rollout 5% for tenant acme_corp
flagsctl set feature.per_customer.smart_routing acme_corp rollout_5 --actor sam

# enable on for multiple tenants
flagsctl set feature.per_customer.smart_routing acme_corp,bigretail,boutique_llc on --actor alex_r
```
dana: I'll create dashboards and attach alerts; will post links when ready.
morgan: @alex_r please add the allowlist creation migration + the RBAC check to the PR and tag with 'enterprise-rollout'. I'll merge if no objections. Plan to merge EOD and start canary tomorrow 10:00 PST.
alex_r: Will add migration + RBAC and tests. ETA EOD today. If no blockers I'll merge tomorrow morning.
priya: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: PR#3214 merged into main at 2026-03-17T17:03:00Z (dry-run checks passed)
dana: Posted monitoring dashboard here: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz/enterprise-rollouts — added alerts for p95 & error rate.
morgan: I'll do T+1h and T+24h manual checks and post status. Thanks everyone — let's keep comments in the PR for code bits and use this thread for ops/contract questions.
